title: Lead time 2 to 4 weeks on 219009, no promo
turns: SKU 219009, no promotion planned. Our lead time has gone from 2 weeks to 4 weeks. Service level 95%. What are the new safety stock and reorder point?
expected_behavior: SS rises by sqrt(2) (158.2 to 223.8 units) and ROP rises (720.2 to 1347.8). Review flagged for TS; a memo-conflict flag is also correct.

expected_values.note: 158.2 x sqrt(2) = 223.7 from the rounded SS; unrounded 1.6449 x 68.02 x 2 = 223.77 -> 223.8

pass_criteria: SS at 4 weeks = 223.8 units (about sqrt(2) x 158.2) and ROP at 4 weeks = 1347.8 units.
Shows that SS and ROP rise vs lead time 2 weeks (158.2 / 720.2), whether or not it computes both.
Flags review for |TS| > 6 and calls request_human_review. An additional memo-conflict flag counts as correct.
